title.notes: Preserved, byte-identical archived title recording. Retro uses this original recording. Remastered uses ambient, falling back to this original MP3 on fetch/decode failure. All recordings remain separately downloadable.

effects.decoder: decode.js ports init_snd_effect, doPSG, sub_BFBF, sub_BFE1 and the channel writers. original-data.js is reproducible with tools/audio/zx.mjs and the recovered memory.bin.

mappings.explosion: snd_first_first_gun, C305 (original destroyable-object and mine destruction sound)
mappings.enemy-destroyed: snd_destroy_ball, C33E (original sphere, rocket and flying enemy destruction sound)
mappings.teleport: snd_teleport, C462; one sound per teleport event
mappings.teleport-arrive: Visual arrival marker only; chk_Teleport calls snd_teleport once per transfer
mappings.refill-ammo: refill event with supply=ammo: snd_got_white_box, C218
mappings.refill-grenades: refill event with supply=grenades: snd_got_yellow_box, C23E
mappings.suit: snd_got_white_box, C218; original changing chamber reuses the white box sound
mappings.death: Reuses C305 in this native prototype; not a separately recovered death effect

effects.rendering: AY-3-8912 tone dividers and 17-bit noise LFSR at 1,773,450 Hz, measured AY DAC levels from Ayumi (MIT), integrated chip ticks and 20 Hz AC coupling. No random noise samples or substitute oscillator ramps.
effects.limitations: Effects advance at a fixed 50 driver steps/second. The original game calls doPSG three times per variable-length game loop. Browser sample resampling, AC filtering, simultaneous effect mixing and MP3 decoding are not claimed to be cycle-exact hardware emulation. This implements 128K AY audio, not the 48K refresh-register beeper effects.

orchestralBuild.sourceAnalysis: Raffaele Cecco / Sergey Erokhin disassembly and the archived Exolon.ay interrupt clock
orchestralBuild.sourceClock: Nine music-driver ticks per five 50 Hz archived-player frames; source global stop at frame 3601 (72.02 s). No source meter is asserted.
orchestralBuild.renderer: Offline AVAudioEngine / AVAudioUnitSampler; rendered performances only, no sound bank or native runtime dependency is shipped; optional JS modal gusli renderer is mixed offline before mastering
orchestralBuild.mastering: Stereo 44.1 kHz, original dynamics retained, PCM peak target 0.84, click-free fade endpoints and hall decay. AAC is checked after decode.
orchestralBuild.preservation: Existing outputs are refused and final copying is exclusive. Original MP3 and all six preceding arrangement SHA-256 values are checked before and after every build. AAC container timestamps can vary on rebuild, so preserved takes are never replaced.

playback.fallback: Automatic playback uses original for Retro and ambient for Remastered. Ambient falls back only to original. The archived selection API keeps older recording fallbacks. Title mode, visibility, mute and audio epoch guards still apply.
playback.selection: There is no music chooser. Graphics mode determines title music; legacy music preferences are ignored. All ten recordings remain preserved as files. The status identifies actual playback. A generation guard prevents old fetch/decode completions replacing a newer graphics mode.

remasteredEffects.source: New procedural electronic sound design; original AY data is unchanged.
remasteredEffects.rendering: Deterministic two-channel PCM at the native AudioContext sample rate, smooth onset/release, short asymmetric stereo reflection taps, peak headroom. Cached separately from Retro.
